Definition: from G1519 and G1209; to take into one's favor:--receive.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to take into one's favour, to receive with welcome, and Paul uses it once, quoting the prophet. Come out from among them, and be separate, and I will receive you, says the Lord, and the promise that follows is that He will be a Father to us and we shall be His sons and daughters. One word of welcome holds the whole adoption.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's welcome is the reason to come out from the world, because separation is not His punishment but the way into His arms.
